NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit 12.4 Redistributable Notice

The optional whisper.cpp CUDA runtime contains selected CUDA Runtime, cuBLAS,
cuBLASLt, NVBLAS, and NVRTC DLL families listed as redistributable components
in Attachment A of the NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit 12.4 EULA.

Pinned license terms:
https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/12.4.0/eula/index.html

This notice records the reviewed license boundary; it does not replace or
modify NVIDIA's license terms. The application must distribute this notice,
the pinned EULA reference, and the whisper.cpp MIT notice with the optional
CUDA runtime. A missing notice keeps that runtime out of the ready state.
